title: Collie's VR Pack
description: A VR pack based on both GingasVR and Ryan Clifford's packs!
body:
This modpack was based on GingasVR's Immersive VR modpack and Ryan Clifford's VR Experience 2 modpack, with some little additions of my own. It provides a more immersive VR experience by adding new animations, biomes, structures, sounds, proximity voice chat, QoL updates, and performance fixes.

If you're looking for the definitive way to increase your vanilla VR immersion, this pack is for you!

[this modpack is still a w.i.p.]
